biocs.name: Uncommon AppID Access
biocs.description: Detection of a user accessing an uncommon AppID during process execution
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'malware.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
